note: What is being evaluated. The dataset says what it is asked and what right looks like; this says what produces the answer. Here the answer comes from a running server, so a regression in the deployment shows up as a failed case rather than as a stale file nobody re-generated.

mcp_server.auth: bearer token in RDM_MCP_BEARER_TOKEN, from the REANA secret store
mcp_server.tls: self-signed as of 2026-09-21, so the card defaults to tls_mode=insecure
mcp_server.tools_verified_from: services/mcp/src/rdm_mcp/server.py in the physics-llm-rdm repository, read 2026-09-21
mcp_server.tools_note: Nine tools, every one annotated read_only_hint=true. This endpoint exposes no rdm_route_request, no panet_search, no catalog_search and no catalog_get_record. An earlier system.json in this repository, on branch deepeval-a-data, names those four; it is wrong and this list supersedes it.

tools_not_exercised.panosc_search: reaches a third-party discovery API whose result set changes, so no expected value can be pinned here
tools_not_exercised.panosc_get_dataset: same, and it needs a dataset id from a search that is not pinned
tools_not_exercised.validate_draft: needs describe_schema to succeed first; add cases once the alps path is confirmed green against the deployment

reference.golden_source: the physics-llm-rdm context release the server reads
reference.note: Each expected value is followed to one of these files, named per case in source_file. A phrase those files do not fix, such as one that falls through to PaNET's live SPARQL endpoint, is marked reference-free rather than given an invented golden.

metrics.judge_note: None. This card has no model endpoint, so a judged metric would have nothing to run against. All three gating metrics are DeepEval metrics that consult no model.
metrics.fallback: When the deepeval install fails, the same comparison is computed in plain Python and each case records which path produced its number.

gate.note: A case with no actual_output was never answered and is not scored. Without a token every case is in that state and the card still writes a report. A call that succeeded and returned no value for the field the case asks about is different: actual_output becomes the JSON literal null, the case is scored, and it fails.
